facebook.caption:
461 reviews. 4.5 stars. For a vegan restaurant in Phu Quoc.

Nhà Hàng Chay NẤM on Đường Nguyễn Trãi is doing something right. Plant-based Vietnamese dishes, $15-30 per person, and a crowd that keeps coming back. No meat, no gimmicks. Just food that actually delivers.

If you think vegan dining means sad salads, this place will change your mind fast.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Watch the plates land at Nhà Hàng Chay NẤM and try to tell me you miss the meat. 461 people rated this 4.5 stars for a reason. Full plant-based menu, Phu Quoc prices, zero compromise on flavor.
